Name: Blinder
Description:
Blinder calms the chaos of high-stakes media management.

Our high-performance media management system makes it simple to protect Talent’s privacy, keep Media happy, and give Comms teams control and visibility over every interview. 

It’s media management made easy.

We started in pro sport (working with the likes of New Zealand Rugby and US Women's Soccer, along with clubs from the AFL to the NFL) and now support world-leading teams from sport, education, entertainment, big business and the public sector.

Name: FashioNZ
Description:
As the first fashion website in the country FashioNZ has been leading the way online since 1998. A well respected and influential online magazine as well as a resource for the local industry, FashioNZ connects fashion and beauty brands with an engaged audience. 

FashioNZ’s readers are spread throughout the country and enjoy the informative, entertaining and thought-provoking mix of content served up daily on FashioNZ.co.nz. Reading FashioNZ keeps them up to date with what’s going on in fashion and beauty in an inclusive and inspiring way. FashioNZ is accessible, savvy and a go-to for local fashion and beauty fans.

FashioNZ is an independent 100% New Zealand owned media company

Name: Dish
Description:
Dish is a multi-award-winning magazine and New Zealand’s most loved foodie title. We are our audience’s go-to source for recipes, reviews, drinks, travel, interviews and lifestyle inspiration.
Our continued growth and cross-platform success across print, digital and events is thanks to the powerful connections and credibility we have spent 20 years fostering with our audience - our community!
The Dish community gets enormous value from our high-quality, achievable, trusted recipes, our dedication to excellent editorial content, and our unparalleled insights on home cooking, wine and beverage, hospitality, travel and lifestyle.
Owned by SCG Media.

Name: Winepilot
Description:
Winepilot is a trusted authority that delivers free reviews, stories, digital content and experiences internationally to help people around the world drink better and get more out of every sip. To do so our team of wine critics and sommeliers from some of the world's top restaurants taste day and night to uncover the very best wine, beer and spirits. 

But we're a little different too. We don't just provide reviews and scores, we give recommendations on our personal favourites to help our readers drink better everyday. From Pet Nat to Single Malt Scotch, Winepilot is your ultimate drinks guide.

Name: Empty Spaces
Description:
Founded in 2024, Empty Spaces is an unapologetic pulse for everything music and pop culture. We cover both emerging local talent as well as global movers and shakers, cutting through the noise and diving deep into the sounds that are redefining New Zealand's modern scene.

We provide a range of media opportunities across multiple audience segments in New Zealand. Send an email to hello@emptyspaces.co.nz for more information.

Name: Five AM
Description:
Five AM was founded in 2017 as a production studio in Aotearoa (New Zealand) and has since evolved into a multi-disciplinary independent music company. Today, we operate across record label services, distribution, publishing, touring, sync, and creative production, supporting artists, writers, and producers at every stage of their careers.

Based in Auckland and working globally, Five AM partners with over 400 artists and collaborators, delivering structure, strategy, and execution across music releases, live projects, and commercial opportunities. Our work spans recorded music, touring, publishing administration, sync, and visual creative, including music videos and campaign content.

Alongside our music operations, Five AM functions as a creative agency, developing visual identities, music videos, and content-led campaigns that sit alongside each release. We take a holistic approach, ensuring the creative and operational sides of a project move together.

Since launching, Five AM has grown into one of the largest independent, privately owned music services companies in the Oceanic region, built on long-term thinking, artist-first principles, and a focus on quality over everything.
